articles.title: Power Supply to Several Kashmir Areas to Be Affected on Multiple Dates: KPDCL - Kashmir Life
articles.full_text:
SRINAGAR: Power supply to several areas of Ganderbal and Anantnag districts will remain affected on November 11, 12, 18 and 21 due to scheduled shutdowns of three 33 kV transmission lines, the Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) has announced.
According to the Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL, the shutdown of the 33 kV Duderhama Tapline and 33 kV Wayil Tapline, emanating from RS Power House, will affect electricity supply to Arhama, PTS Manigam, Duderhama, Wayil, Gutlibagh, Dursoo, Wahidpora, Harran, District Hospital Ganderbal, Industrial Estate Ganderbal, Tawheed Chowk and adjoining areas.
The shutdown will be observed from 9 am to 3 pm on November 11, 18 and 21.
Separately, the 33 kV Zirpora Tapline will remain shut down on November 12 from 10 am to 2 pm, affecting power supply to Veer, Nowbugh, Srigufwara, Kanalwan, Bewoora, Darigund, Thajiwara, Dupatyar and adjoining areas.
The shutdowns have been scheduled as part of maintenance-related work on the respective transmission lines.
